Control_Objective: Access is granted only with proper authorization
Control_Activity: New user access requests require documented manager and system-owner approval before provisioning
Test_Procedure: Sample 25 new-user grants; verify documented approval predates access

Control_Activity: User access to financial systems is recertified by managers quarterly
Test_Procedure: Inspect quarterly recertification evidence for all 4 quarters
Remediation: Formalize and enforce quarterly access recertification with tracked completion

Control_Objective: Access is removed when no longer needed
Control_Activity: Access for terminated employees is revoked within 24 hours of separation
Test_Procedure: Sample 15 terminations; verify access revoked within SLA
Remediation: Automate deprovisioning via HR-triggered workflow; monitor SLA

Control_Activity: Administrative/privileged access is limited to authorized personnel and reviewed
Test_Procedure: Inspect admin user list; verify business justification and review

Control_Activity: Password policy and MFA are enforced on financial systems per standard
Test_Procedure: Inspect IdP configuration for password and MFA settings

Control_Activity: Segregation-of-duties rules prevent a single user from initiating and approving transactions
Test_Procedure: Run SoD conflict report; inspect for unresolved conflicts
Remediation: Implement SoD ruleset and remediate the identified conflicting grants

Control_Activity: Production changes require documented approval before deployment
Test_Procedure: Sample 25 production changes; verify approval predates deployment

Control_Activity: Changes are tested and results documented prior to production release
Test_Procedure: Sample 25 changes; verify test evidence exists

Control_Activity: Developers do not have standing access to deploy to production (deployer != developer)
Test_Procedure: Inspect production deployment access; verify developers lack standing prod access
Remediation: Remove developer standing prod access; route deployments through controlled CI/CD with approval

Control_Activity: Emergency changes follow a defined process and receive retrospective review and approval
Test_Procedure: Sample emergency changes; verify retrospective approval

Control_Objective: New systems follow a controlled SDLC
Control_Activity: Major system implementations follow an SDLC with approvals at defined stage gates
Test_Procedure: Inspect SDLC documentation for the sampled implementation project

Control_Objective: Data migration is accurate and complete
Control_Activity: Data conversion/migration is validated and reconciled before go-live
Test_Procedure: Inspect migration reconciliation evidence for the project

Control_Activity: User acceptance testing (UAT) is performed and signed off before go-live
Test_Procedure: Inspect UAT sign-off for the sampled project

Control_Activity: Batch jobs are scheduled and monitored; failures are investigated and resolved
Backups are performed per schedule and periodically tested for restorability
Test_Procedure: Inspect backup logs and evidence of restore testing
Remediation: Establish and document periodic restore testing with retained evidence

Control_Activity: IT incidents and problems are logged, tracked, and resolved
Test_Procedure: Sample 25 incidents; verify tracking and resolution
